title: Repair round-robin consumption of ragged rows
goal: Implement round_robin_drain(rows) for a list of lists of integers. In each round, visit the original rows in their original order and append the next unconsumed element from every row that still has one. Continue rounds until all rows are exhausted. Exhausting one row must not skip or reorder another row in that round. Preserve order within each row and preserve duplicates. Initially empty rows contribute nothing. Empty outer input and all-empty rows return []. Return a new flat list without modifying the outer list or any inner row.
constraints: Only edit solution.py; do not add files or dependencies or modify tests.
Keep the public function name and one-argument signature unchanged.
Assume rows is a list of lists of integers.
